name: Library Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or in a rack at about knee height.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Hinge to position your shoulders over the bar with a flat back.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips and knees to stand.
Lower the bar back to the supports under control.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A deadlift variant that uses a partial range with the bar lifted from an elevated start to focus on the upper portion of the pull.
